messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: 'RATE_QUOTA_ANOMALY' fired for service=rate-limiter-prod; severity=high; triggered_by=quota-enforcer v2 rollout. Incident key: pd-8f3a2

pagerduty: Details: 429 spikes across multiple routes. Primary signal: global 5xx/4xx alarm crossing threshold. See: https://pd.example.com/incidents/pd-8f3a2

alex_m (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Brief summary?

jen_sre: saw the alert. Grafana shows a sudden jump in 429 rate at 12:11:04 UTC, started ~30s after the config rollout (rate-enforcer:v2). Most 429s are for token bucket rejection on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Top affected customers: acme-payments, quickcart.

priya_eng: Confirming: we pushed a change to per-tenant quota enforcement that tightened default burst to 0. It should have been opt-in. Looks like config toggled globally during the rollout.

luis_support: Support already getting tickets: multiple customers reporting 'requests throttled - 429'. Sending a note to acme-payments now.

eng-runtime: I can rollback the config or flip the feature-flag. Which do you want? If we flip the feature-flag it avoids a full rollout rollback.

alex_m (oncall): Flip flag first for fastest mitigation. What's the flag name?

priya_eng: Flag is quotas.v2_enforce_global=true. Toggle to false. I have CLI access.

jen_sre: Runbook (rate-limiter -> emergency rollback) link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rate-limiter-emergency.md. Recommended steps: 1) disable enforcement flag 2) scale limiter pods to 0/1 if needed 3) monitor 429 rate and error budgets.

priya_eng: Executing now:
```bash
# disable global enforcement
kubectl -n infra patch configmap rate-enforcer --type merge -p '{"data":{"v2_enforce_global":"false"}}'
# confirm rollout status
kubectl -n infra rollout status deploy/rate-enforcer -w --timeout=60s
```

incident-bot: Action logged: configmap patched by priya_eng at 12:13:02 UTC.

eng-runtime: I also queued a rollback to previous config commit (abc123) in case patch doesn't stick: `rlctl rollback --service rate-enforcer --commit abc123`

jen_sre: Metrics check: 30s after patch, 429 rate dropped from 4.2k/min to ~180/min. Latency unaffected. Continuing to monitor.

luis_support: Drafting customer notification: "We identified a quota enforcement regression after a recent config change that temporarily tightened burst limits. We've disabled the new enforcement and are monitoring; service should be normalizing. We're following up with a root cause and timeline." Want me to send the initial message to affected customers?

maria_custsuccess: Please send to acme-payments and quickcart now. Mark as high-priority and CC their engineering leads.

alex_m (oncall): Go ahead, Luis. Include a temporary mitigation note and ETA for full resolution (30-60m). Also log incident in incidents channel.

luis_support: Sent to affected customers at 12:15 UTC. Sample: "We're sorry for the throttling — mitigation in progress, expect normal traffic in <1m. We'll follow up with postmortem"

jen_sre: Observability: adding short-term alert mute for noisy downstream alarms and enabling a dedicated dashboard to track per-tenant 429s for the next 2 hours.

priya_eng: Feature flag flip confirmed propagated to all pods. Verified via `kubectl get configmap rate-enforcer -o jsonpath='{.data.v2_enforce_global}'` -> false

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert status: acknowledged by alex_m (oncall) at 12:13:10 UTC. No escalations fired.

eng-runtime: Confirming rollback queued succeeded (commit abc123) at 12:14:20 UTC. Rolling pods restarted.

jen_sre: 12:16:05 UTC - 429s back to baseline (<50/min). Marking incident as mitigated.

alex_m (oncall): Great. I'm going to perform a handoff to jen_sre for postmortem and follow-up on changelist hygiene. Handoff notes: root cause likely bad default in config change, missing canary gating; immediate fix: flip flag + rollback; follow-ups: add automated canary tests for quota changes, require opt-in for v2 enforce, require runbook link in PR.

jen_sre: Taking postmortem. Assigned: jen_sre (owner), priya_eng (cause & fix), eng-runtime (release process), luis_support (customer comms). Timeline: INCIDENT_OPEN=12:11:04 UTC, MITIGATED=12:16:05 UTC. Impact: temporary 429s affecting ~2 customers for ~5 minutes; internal alert noise.

maria_custsuccess: Thanks team — I'll follow up with account managers and offer a 1:1 debrief for impacted customers.

incident-bot: Incident closed as mitigated by alex_m (oncall) at 12:17:30 UTC. Postmortem requested: https://incidents.redwood/postmortems/pd-8f3a2

alex_m (oncall): Quick action items: 1) enforce PR checklist item for quota toggles (priyaa) 2) add canary gating in rollout for rate-enforcer (eng-runtime) 3) write automated canary test for 429/regression (jen_sre). I'll follow up in the postmortem thread. :white_check_mark:
